text:
ashleigh: Heads-up: console p99 for /v2/stream shot up to ~950ms at 09:40 but when I drill into the endpoint breakdown p99 is ~270ms. chart looks like a single big spike in the aggregate.
devin: Could be KV-cache hit distribution — prefix-cached requests are way faster. Does the aggregate include proxy/client origins?
rachel: I remember we changed the default aggregation window and origin merge last month. endpoint slices may show server-only by default.
theo: I grabbed a small sample of raw events around 09:38-09:42. ingress line: `ingress: endpoint=/v2/stream origin=proxy route=canary fallback=true latency_ms=928 cache_hit=false retry_count=1`
metrics-bot: metrics: sample_counts -> aggregate: 2300, server-origin: 1980, proxy-origin: 320. proxy p99=912ms, server p99=268ms.
devin: There you go. Two things: 1) fallback proxy path has much higher tail, 2) retries are present in the proxy samples. Both bump aggregate p99.
ashleigh: UX issue — the sparkline legend just shows p50/p95/p99 but not where those numbers came from. makes oncall jump to wrong conclusions.
rachel: Proposal: add an origin breakdown badge (tiny) on the percentile row and a hover that lists count and p50/p95/p99 per origin, plus a note if retries are included.
theo: Also suggest an "align semantics" toggle when comparing aggregate vs endpoint slices: either show both with merged origins or both with origin-filtered semantics.
devin: Implementation is straightforward: telemetry already exposes `sample_origin` and `retry_count`. query snippet to reproduce: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, sample_origin, count(*) FROM telemetry.samples WHERE endpoint='/v2/stream' AND time >= '2026-03-22T09:30Z' AND time <= '2026-03-22T09:50Z' GROUP BY sample_origin ORDER BY p99 DESC;
ashleigh: Can we also include cache_hit breakdown? KV cache misses in the fallback path make tails worse.
metrics-bot: note: telemetry schema includes `cache_hit` boolean. returning per-origin per-cache-hit percentiles adds clarity.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary/2026-03-22.09 rolled to us-east at 09:35 — likely increased fallback traffic until 09:39.
rachel: Action items: short-term console patch to show origin pill + hover counts; mid-term: add an "include retries" toggle and a provenance alignment setting. I'll draft the UX spec.
devin: I'll add the API flag to telemetry service (include_retries=false by default).
theo: I'll prototype the hover panel and include cache_hit slices.
ashleigh: thanks — this should cut down false positives in next oncall rotation.
